# Global Systems Studio

> Global Systems Studio is the home of ROS (Relocation Operating System), step-by-step infrastructure for U.S. persons relocating internationally. Seven modules. Six tiers. Real answers. Founded by Charlene L. M. Cupidore Bynoe.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/): Overview of ROS and the Global Systems Studio approach.
- [Work With Me](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/work-with-me/): Advisory services plus Guides & Workbooks, ten entry-level digital products for people planning an international move.
- [Free guide: Five Questions Before Moving Abroad](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/shop/five-questions/): Free download for anyone deciding whether a relocation will work.
- [Blog](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/blog/): Country relocation guides, tax and residency explainers, and answers to common expat questions.
- [Tools](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/tools/): Planning tools for relocation.
- [Podcast](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/podcast/): Conversations about relocating internationally.

## Topics covered

- Relocation planning for U.S. persons
- Residency and visa pathways by country
- Tax position and compliance considerations for expats
- Real costs of relocating (Paraguay, Costa Rica, Mexico, Malaysia, Turkey, Ireland and more)
- Document organization, pets, and digital nomad compliance
